_note: Release manifest — single source of truth for install.sh, `teaport update`, and box OTA. All URLs served from get.teaspoon.tech (no HF, no binaries repo). Placeholder values until the first release is cut.

g2p_dict._note: en-us G2P lexicon (teagram-engine engine/g2p/kokoro_g2p.dict). GENERATED FROM the misaki en-US gold/silver lexicons (Apache-2.0, hexgrad and the misaki contributors, https://github.com/hexgrad/misaki) by teagram-engine tools/g2p_dict_convert.py, which flattens POS entries to DEFAULT and merges silver under gold — a derivative work, not a file copied from misaki. Attribution ships in the engine's THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt. MUST install to bin/g2p/ — without it the engine silently degrades to espeak-only G2P and prosody goes robotic (2026-08-05). Arch-independent; rides the engine release.
